description: Reconciled order confirmation with ADR-0033 and repaired migration ancestry; process PostgreSQL tests exposed an accounting period date bug.

asi.hypothesis: Server-derived order lines and accounting profiles will close the ADR-0033 reconciliation gate.
asi.rollback_reason: Accounting period lookup still reports closed despite an open 2000-2099 period; changes reverted by experiment harness.
asi.next_action_hint: Fix utcDate: tests run with the Effect test clock at epoch, so posting date resolves to 1970-01-01. Use a provided current date/test clock or open period covering epoch in process tests, then reapply the captured ADR-0033 diff.
